subject: Trying to access to another shiny account.

messages.author: c1d6f503435caafe
messages.subject: Trying to access to another shiny account.
parts:
Hi guys. I have a problem here. There's this shinyapps domain https://homie-ds.shinyapps.io/sales-app/ and i was allowed to have access to grant permissions to users and stuff (last time it was touched was around 2 months ago).

Now that i logged in again it asked me to create an account, select a new domain, which i did (homiemx). 

I tried to deploy something new there using the info provided by the dashboard

rsconnect::setAccountInfo(name='homiemx',token='XXXXXXXX',secret='XXXXXXXXX')
rsconnect::deployApp('sales-app/')

but it ends up deploying https://homie-ds.shinyapps.io/sales-app/

Is there something wrong with shiny? I don't understand why i was asked to create a new domain or why i no longer have access to homie-ds (nobody removed me), but more strangely, why deploying using the new stuff (homiemx) still deploys to (homie-ds)

Thanks in advance for your help.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Trying to access to another shiny account.
parts:
It sounds like you accidentally created a new account by logging in with a different email address then what your original account was created with. It sounds like you have a paid account (homie-ds), so I suggest you contact RStudio Support, to get this resolved.

Best,
-Andy
